map.：进口关税 = 50000 × 0.10 = 5,000 元；含税成本 = 50: : import duty = 50000 × 0.10 = 5,000 CNY; tax-inclusive cost = 50000 + 5000 = 55,000 CNY (excluding import VAT).

map.完税价格含运费和保险费吗？: Does the dutiable value include freight and insurance?
map.进口从价税通常以 CIF（成本+保险费+运费）为完税价格，具体以海关审定为准。: Ad valorem import duty usually takes CIF (cost + insurance + freight) as the dutiable value, subject to customs assessment.
map.关税和进口增值税如何叠加？: How do tariff and import VAT stack up?
map.先算关税，进口增值税一般按（完税价格+关税）为组成计税依据计征。: Compute the tariff first; import VAT is generally levied on the composite basis of (dutiable value + tariff).
